FlixDesk Preferences

Playback Enhancements

Automated playback controls and video resolution unlocks.

Automatically skips opening intro sequences when the button appears.

Automatically skips previous episode summaries.

Seamlessly transitions to the next episode when credits roll.

Overrides Netflix's 720p Linux default and requests 1080p AVC/H.264 profiles (~5800 kbps).

Linux Desktop & System Integration

Integrations tailored for Pop!_OS COSMIC, GNOME, KDE, and Wayland.

Enables keyboard media keys, GNOME top bar controls, and lock screen media player widget.

Displays an icon in the Linux system tray with quick playback actions.

Minimizes the window to the system tray instead of exiting when closed.

Uses GPU decoding for smoother playback and lower CPU / battery usage. (Requires restart)

Runs natively under Wayland on Pop!_OS, GNOME, and KDE. (Requires restart)

Discord Rich Presence

Share your watching activity on Discord automatically.

Displays "Watching <Title> on FlixDesk" on your Discord profile.

Includes detailed episode names and season information in your Discord status.
